recognize_zh: 整片骨髓被大小不等的芽細胞取代：小的核圓、細胞質極少，大的有少量淡藍色無顆粒細胞質、核有切跡並可見小核仁，無 Auer rod；此影像與 1844 為同一張圖。
features: Blasts of variable size, from small with scant cytoplasm to larger with moderate pale blue cytoplasm
High N:C ratio overall with round, oval or notched nuclei
Fine chromatin; small nucleoli apparent in larger blasts
Few small dark lymphoid cells interspersed; no residual maturing myeloid or erythroid elements in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is replaced by a heterogeneous population of blasts. The blasts vary from small cells with scant cytoplasm to larger cells with moderate agranular pale blue cytoplasm, notched nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli. Auer rods and granules are absent, and normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not seen in this field. Findings are compatible with lymphoblastic leukemia; lineage must be confirmed by flow cytometry. (This image file is identical to record 1844.)

ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; blasts express CD13/CD33/CD117 and MPO by flow rather than CD19/CD10/CD79a.
Monoblasts have more abundant, often vacuolated cytoplasm with folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive.
